$comment: Implements spec 03 §3 (structural model: stages, levels, pathways and the calendar template). This file is the schema for structure.json.
title: Curriculum pack structure (structure.json)
description: Stages, levels, pathways and the calendar template a programme instantiates (spec 03 §3).

stages.description: Ordered bands of schooling, for example Pre-primary, Lower Primary, Junior School or KS3 (spec 03 §3). Stage order is the array order.

levels.description: Every level a programme can place a learner in. Codes are unique within the pack (runtime check).

pathways.description: Senior-school pathways or A-Level combinations (spec 03 §3, Appendix A). Optional: a primary-only pack has none.

levels.description: Level codes belonging to this stage, in order. Each must be declared in levels (runtime check).

ordinal.description: Global position within the programme, used by promotion. Spec 02 §4 defines ordinal as global within a programme.

typical_age.description: Typical age in years at entry to the level (spec 03 §3 example: G7 has typical_age 12).

next.description: The level a learner normally moves to. null marks the end of a programme. The code must resolve to a declared level (runtime check).

is_stage_exit.description: True when leaving this level ends a stage and needs a stage transition, for example G9 to Senior School (spec 03 §3, §7).

national_assessment.description: Code of the national assessment taken at this level, for example KJSEA at G9, or null when there is none (spec 03 §3). No national weights are hard-coded in the pack (Appendix A).

levels.description: Levels in which this pathway is offered, for example G10 to G12 for Kenya Senior School (spec 03 §3).

year_kind.description: calendar_year runs January to December (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania); academic_year runs September to July (British packs, Appendix C). A programme's academic years are created from this template.

periods.description: Reporting periods in sequence. Half-terms nest inside terms (spec 02 §3).

note.description: Free text for the setup wizard, for example that exact dates are published annually by the ministry (spec 03 §3).

code.description: Optional stable period code used by annual weights and conformance vectors, for example T1. When absent the engine uses T{sequence}.

kind.description: Period kind from spec 02 §3. Pack examples use terms; British packs may use three terms with half-terms and Francophone packs three trimestres.

sequence.description: Order within the year, starting at 1 (spec 03 §3, spec 02 §3 academic_period.sequence).

typical.description: Typical start and end as MM-DD in the institution time zone. The wizard pre-fills these and the school confirms the exact dates (spec 03 §3).

half_term.description: True when a mid-term break falls inside this period (spec 03 §3).
